$comment: CryptoClaw — .claude/settings.json. Committed to the repo (team-shared). Personal overrides go in .claude/settings.local.json (gitignored).

PostToolUse.$comment: Auto-format TS/JS/JSON/MD/YAML/Prisma with Prettier on every Edit/Write. Soft-fails so a missing prettier doesn't block work; the lint CI gate is the hard backstop.

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx|*.js|*.mjs|*.cjs|*.json|*.md|*.yaml|*.yml|*.prisma) cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && pnpm exec prettier --write --log-level=warn "$FILE" 2>&1 | tail -3 || true ;; esac

PostToolUse.$comment: Block console.* in TypeScript source under apps/, libs/, sdk/cclaw/. Allowed in tests/, scripts/ (legacy), and *.config.* files. Mirrors SPEC §11 — libs/logger (nestjs-pino) is the logger; console is a sign of forgotten debug output.

hooks.command: FILE=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.file_path // empty'); case "$FILE" in *.ts|*.tsx) case "$FILE" in *test*|*spec*|*scripts/*|*.config.*) exit 0 ;; esac; case "$FILE" in *apps/*|*libs/*|*sdk/cclaw/*) if grep -qE '\bconsole\.(log|debug|info|warn|error)\b' "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; then echo "BLOCKED: console.* in $FILE — use the libs/logger pino logger (SPEC §11)." >&2; exit 2; fi ;; esac ;; esac

PreToolUse.$comment: Hard-block direct pushes to main/master and any force-push variant. Bypassing this should never be possible from a Claude Code session.

hooks.command: CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+(origin[[:space:]]+)?(main|master)([[:space:]]|$)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: direct push to main/master — open a PR.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE 'git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+.*(--force|-f|--force-with-lease)'; then echo 'BLOCKED: force push is denied on this repo.' >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

PreToolUse.$comment: Pre-commit scan: block staged secrets (.env, .env.runtime, secrets/<not-example>, *.session) and source-file console.* in apps/+libs/+sdk/cclaw/ before they get committed.

hooks.command: CMD=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | jq -r '.command // empty'); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE '^[[:space:]]*git[[:space:]]+commit'; then cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" || exit 0; STAGED=$(git diff --cached --name-only 2>/dev/null); if echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '(^|/)(\.env($|\.[^/]+$)|\.env\.runtime($|\..+$)|.+\.session$)' | grep -vE '\.example$' >/dev/null 2>&1 || echo "$STAGED" | grep -qE '^\.env($|\.[^/]+$)' | grep -v 'example'; then echo 'BLOCKED: secret-like file is staged. Unstage and reconsider.' >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$STAGED" | grep -E '^secrets/' | grep -vE '\.example$' | grep -q .; then echo 'BLOCKED: file under secrets/ is staged (only secrets/*.example may be tracked).' >&2; exit 2; fi; SRCDIFF=$(git diff --cached -- 'apps/**/*.ts' 'apps/**/*.tsx' 'libs/**/*.ts' 'libs/**/*.tsx' 'sdk/cclaw/**/*.ts' 2>/dev/null); if echo "$SRCDIFF" | grep -qE '^\+.*\bconsole\.(log|debug|info|warn|error)\b'; then echo 'BLOCKED: staged console.* in apps/+libs/+sdk/cclaw/ — use libs/logger, then re-stage.' >&2; exit 2; fi; fi; exit 0

SessionStart.$comment: Print current phase, ADR count, branch, and uncommitted-files count so every session opens with the right operating context.

hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" 2>/dev/null && echo '=== CryptoClaw ===' && PHASE=$(grep -A1 '^## Current phase' CLAUDE.md 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 | sed 's/^/  /') && [ -n "$PHASE" ] && echo "$PHASE" || echo '  Phase: see SPEC.md §18 (no "## Current phase" in CLAUDE.md)'; ADRS=$(ls docs/decisions/*.md 2>/dev/null | grep -v README.md | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && echo "  ADRs in docs/decisions/: $ADRS"; BR=$(git branch --show-current 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$BR" ] && echo "  Branch: $BR"; AHEAD=$(git rev-list --count main..HEAD 2>/dev/null) && [ -n "$AHEAD" ] && [ "$AHEAD" != "0" ] && echo "  Commits ahead of main: $AHEAD"; UNCOMMITTED=$(git status --porcelain 2>/dev/null | wc -l | tr -d ' ') && [ "$UNCOMMITTED" != "0" ] && echo "  Uncommitted files: $UNCOMMITTED"; exit 0
